ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $P$ is a point inside $\angle AOB$. The symmetric point of $P$ with respect to $OA$ is $C$, and the symmetric point of $P$ with respect to $OB$ is $D$. Connect $CD$ intersecting $OA$, $OB$ at points $M$ and $N$ respectively, and then connect $PM$, $PN$. If $\angle AOB=50^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle MPN$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect PC, PM, PD, PN. \\
$\because$ Point P is symmetrical to point C with respect to line OA, and to point D with respect to line OB, \\
$\therefore OC=OP=OD$, $\angle AOP=\angle AOC$, $\angle POB=\angle BOD$, \\
$\because \angle AOB=50^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle COD=2\angle AOB=100^\circ$. $\because OC=OP$, $\angle AOP=\angle AOC$, $OM=OM$ $\therefore \triangle OCM\cong \triangle OPM$, $\therefore \angle OCM=\angle OPM$, similarly $\angle ODN=\angle OPN$ \\
$\therefore \angle MPN=\angle OPM+\angle OPN=\angle OCM+\angle ODN=180^\circ−2\angle AOB=\boxed{80^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: Use a direct reflection-of-lines argument. From the image, CD is one straight line meeting OA at M and OB at N, with ray MC and ray ND pointing in opposite directions along the same line. Because C reflects to P across OA and M lies on the mirror OA, the ray MC reflects to ray MP. Because D reflects to P across OB and N lies on the mirror OB, the ray ND reflects to ray NP. Thus the two sides of ∠MPN are obtained by reflecting two opposite rays of the same line CD across the two sides OA and OB of the angle. If two mirrors meet at θ=50°, reflecting opposite rays of one line across the two mirrors makes the angle between the reflected rays equal to 180°−2θ. Therefore ∠MPN=180°−2·50°=80°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中点 O 在左下方，射线 OA 向右上方延伸，射线 OB 向右方近水平延伸，形成角 AOB。点 P 位于角 AOB 内部。点 C 在 OA 的另一侧偏左上方，点 D 在 OB 的另一侧偏右下方。直线 CD 是一条从左上到右下的直线，分别与 OA、OB 相交于 M、N；因此 M、C 在同一直线上，N、D 也在同一直线上，并且射线 MC 与射线 ND 是同一直线上的相反方向。图中还连接了 PM 和 PN。

推理：由题意，C 是 P 关于 OA 的对称点，且 M 在镜面 OA 上，所以反射线段/射线 MC 关于 OA 后得到射线 MP。类似地，D 是 P 关于 OB 的对称点，且 N 在镜面 OB 上，所以射线 ND 关于 OB 反射后得到射线 NP。

因此，∠MPN 的两条边所在方向，可以看成是同一直线 CD 上两个相反射线分别关于两条镜面 OA、OB 反射后的方向。设两面镜 OA、OB 的夹角为 θ=50°。一条射线与其相反射线方向相差 180°；分别关于夹角为 θ 的两条直线反射后，两条反射射线之间的夹角变为 180°−2θ。于是
∠MPN = 180° − 2×50° = 80°。

推理：由题意，C 是 P 关于 OA 的对称点，且 M 在镜面 OA 上，所以反射线段/射线 MC 关于 OA 后得到射线 MP。类似地，D 是 P 关于 OB 的对称点，且 N 在镜面 OB 上，所以射线 ND 关于 OB 反射后得到射线 NP。

因此，∠MPN 的两条边所在方向，可以看成是同一直线 CD 上两个相反射线分别关于两条镜面 OA、OB 反射后的方向。设两面镜 OA、OB 的夹角为 θ=50°。一条射线与其相反射线方向相差 180°；分别关于夹角为 θ 的两条直线反射后，两条反射射线之间的夹角变为 180°−2θ。于是
∠MPN = 180° − 2×50° = 80°。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This avoids triangle congruence and triangle OCD. It treats PM and PN as reflected images of rays on CD and uses the composition/angle effect of reflections in two intersecting lines.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read that M and N are on the same straight line CD, with M on OA and N on OB; ray MC and ray ND are opposite directions along CD; PM and PN are the reflected rays meeting at P.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the stated facts that C is the mirror image of P across OA, D is the mirror image of P across OB, and ∠AOB=50°.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A reflection fixes points on the mirror line and maps a ray through a reflected point to the corresponding reflected ray; the angle between images of opposite rays under reflections in two lines meeting at θ is 180°−2θ.

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, point $P$ is a point inside $\angle AOB$. The symmetric point of $P$ with respect to $OA$ is $C$, and the symmetric point of $P$ with respect to $OB$ is $D$. Connect $CD$, intersecting $OA$ and $OB$ at points $M$ and $N$ respectively, and then connect $PM$ and $PN$. If $\angle AOB=50^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle MPN$ in degrees?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect $PC$, $PM$, $PD$, $PN$. \\
$\because$ point $P$ is symmetrical to point $C$ with respect to line $OA$, and to point $D$ with respect to line $OB$, \\
$\therefore OC=OP=OD$, $\angle AOP=\angle AOC$, $\angle POB=\angle BOD$. \\
$\because \angle AOB=50^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle COD=2\angle AOB=100^\circ$. $\because OC=OP$, $\angle AOP=\angle AOC$, $OM=OM$, $\therefore \triangle OCM\cong \triangle OPM$, $\therefore \angle OCM=\angle OPM$; similarly $\angle ODN=\angle OPN$. \\
$\therefore \angle MPN=\angle OPM+\angle OPN=\angle OCM+\angle ODN=180^\circ-2\angle AOB=\boxed{80^\circ}$
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, O is the vertex of the angle, OA is the side toward the upper right, OB is the horizontal side toward the right, and P is located inside ∠AOB. C is on the other side of OA, and D is on the other side of OB. The straight line CD goes from C through M and N to D, intersecting OA at M and OB at N respectively; PM and PN are connected in the figure. If OP is additionally drawn, then viewed from point P, ray PO is located between PM and PN.
Reasoning: Let θ=∠AOB=50°. Because C is the symmetric point of P with respect to OA, OC=OP, and ∠AOC=∠AOP; because D is the symmetric point of P with respect to OB, OD=OP, and ∠BOD=∠BOP. Therefore ∠COD=2∠AOB=100°. Also because M is on OA, ∠COM=∠MOP, and OC=OP, OM is a common side, so △OCM≅△OPM, thus ∠OCM=∠OPM. Similarly, N is on OB, △ODN≅△OPN, so ∠ODN=∠OPN. Since C, M, N, D are collinear, ∠OCM and ∠ODN are exactly the sum of the two base angles of △OCD at C and D, therefore ∠OCM+∠ODN=180°−∠COD=180°−100°=80°. Also in the figure PO is located inside ∠MPN, so ∠MPN=∠OPM+∠OPN=∠OCM+∠ODN=80°.
